metas.name: ★ 8.7 · 2025 · Takopi's Original Sin
metas.description: Takopi travels from his home of Happy Planet to spread happiness on Earth, but meets the unsmiling Shizuka. Her school friends and home life are causing her somber expression and pure hearted Takopi is determined to change things.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2017 · I'm Not a Robot
metas.description: Kim Min Gyu has wealth and success, but lives an isolated life due to his allergy of people. He then meets and falls in love with a girl who is pretending to be a robot for her ex-boyfriend, a genius robots professor.
